decisions.reason: Premium support sits close to the firm's agency-focused, round-the-clock support model and costs little to keep. As an option with ongoing upsell value, it is still worth more than its carrying cost.

The version manager is built into the firm's established management tooling and was promoted as a current feature in 2019. Its marginal carrying cost is low, so there is no sign the option has resolved negatively.

The data processing contract generator is distant from the core hosting business and its GDPR-driven demand peaked around 2018. By 2022 it has likely resolved as low value, and its resources can go to the hosting platform.
Scalable agency hosting is the flagship of the firm's strategic direction and core to its agency focus. Management would keep investing in it rather than abandon it.
